verdict.rationale: The docs describe asynchronous transcription of recorded audio and video, with the SDK handling local upload, submission and polling in one call; a published OpenAPI spec confirms a documented HTTP API. A synchronous HTTP endpoint with a 20-minute duration cap is also documented, but no evidence lists accepted file formats or file-size limits. Missing for 10: a published list of accepted audio/video formats, documented file-size limits for uploads, and an explicit description of the raw upload endpoint.
